header: Two to four figures, each on its own card
lead: The default results strip. Every figure is typed by an editor and stays until someone edits it again; nothing here is measured, fetched or counted at render time.
note: The note line is where the reporting date belongs, because a figure without a date is a claim without a period.

metrics.title: Cards, minimum
metrics.text: One card is a Big Number, not a row.

metrics.title: Cards, maximum
metrics.text: Past four, the grid reflows and the row stops reading as one thought.

metrics.title: Column below 640px
metrics.text: Whatever the column setting says, a phone gets one.
